mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RETRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS retry_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SENDING' AND (locked_at IS NULL OR locked_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{staleSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stale_sending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dead_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('NEW', 'RETRY', 'SENDING', 'SENT', 'DEAD') OR status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknown_status_count, MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW', 'RETRY', 'SENDING') THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) AS oldest_active_created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AS collected_at FROM message_outbox WHERE source_service = 'ticket-service' AND event_type = 'TICKET_SEARCH_CHANGED' AND topic = #{topic}
